svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: backend: .NET 10, ASP.NET Core, EF Core, MediatR, NestJS, Hono, Bun, Drizzle. frontend: React 19, Next.js, TypeScript, TanStack, Tailwind v4, Vite, Angular, RxJS. mobile: Expo, React Native, Flutter, SwiftUI. data: PostgreSQL, Row-level security, Zod. infra: Docker, GitHub Actions, Turborepo, Vercel, Serilog. quality: xUnit, Vitest, Jest, Playwright. workstation: Arch Linux, Hyprland, Quickshell, kitty, zsh, Claude Code, Git. 39 tools in 7 layers.
